title: mini-audit audit-objective
description: What this audit is trying to prove (Search Governance v1, R2-3). Control plane: canonical, immutable once L1 completes, and replaced only through an explicit revision carrying both --force and --reason. Not agent-writable — an L1 agent writes a proposal under agents/<id>/scratch/ and the runtime promotes it, so the goalposts cannot be moved by the thing being measured.

principal.description: The attacker identity the audit reasons from. Root node of the attack graph, and the second half of every capability's identity.

initial_capabilities.description: What that principal can already do before any bug is found. Seeded into the graph as verified capabilities of objective origin, so 'distance to target' has a real starting point.

target_capabilities.description: One goal node is seeded per entry.

security_invariants.description: Statements the product's intended security model depends on. These are the assumptions an attack path is allowed to break.

revision.description: Starts at 1 and only increases. Replacing an objective without incrementing this is refused.

supersedes.description: Append-only audit trail. Never truncated, never rewritten.

previous_hash.description: Content hash of the objective being replaced (principal + capabilities + invariants), so a later reader can tell which text was superseded.
